Researchers at the University of Huddersfield have created a technique which they claim can distinguish between the genetic fingerprints of identical twins . Identical twins start life with the same genes because they come from the same fertilised egg which divides into two embryos . But as they age different life experiences, such as smoking or diet, create variations in the number of hydrogen bonds in the DNA . Using a technique called high resolution melt curve analysis - or HRMA - researchers can now identify the difference between each twin . The more hydrogen bonds present in DNA, the higher the temperature needed to melt them .

Falkirk beat Hibernian 1-0 in the Scottish Cup semi-final at Hampden Park . Craig Sibbald scored the only goal of the game in the 74th minute . The Bairns will play either Inverness or Celtic in the final on May 30 . Both teams were forced into changes for the all-Championship last-four tie .

Chris Hala'ufia halted Leicester forward Laurence Pearce with a shoulder charge and then shoved his head into the turf . Yaya Toure has hinted that he is open to leaving Manchester City this summer . Toure's agent Dimitri Seluk has revealed that he wants to talk to City about his future . The 31-year-old has two years left on his current contract at the Etihad Stadium . Inter Milan boss Roberto Mancini wants to be reunited with Toure next season .

Marcos Rojo went away during a week off for his club side after Manchester United's 3-1 victory over Aston Villa on Saturday . Fitness instructor Sarah Watson, 34, claims Rojo and his advisors tried to frame her for blackmail after she enjoyed a brief liaison with the United star following a night out . Watson says Rojo offered her money to spend the night with him - which she declined - and accepted a £30,000 offer from a newspaper to sell her story .

George Osborne avoided calls to rule out further help for the country's top earners . Instead he says the Conservatives are committed to raising the tax-free personal allowance . Raising 40 per cent tax so that it only applies to those earning at least £50,000 was also a priority . At present anyone earning between £31,866 to £150,000 is taxed at the higher rate of 45 per cent .

Harrowing images of the killing are being shared by bloodthirsty supporters of the terror group on social media . One of those distributing the sickening pictures is a man claiming to be a British ISIS jihadi . The gruesome photographs are understood to have been taken near Tikrit in Iraq's Salah al-Din province . The exact crime the victim is accused of committing is not known, but images of his violent death were uploaded to Twitter saying he was a 'sorcerer' Execution took place as Iraqi forensic teams working in newly liberated city of Tikrit started exhuming bodies from mass graves believed to contain the bodies of up to 1,700 soldiers brutally murdered by ISIS last year .

Jack Jordan proposed to his girlfriend Laura Cant last Christmas from his hospital bed . The 23-year-old had hoped to undergo a bone marrow transplant to prolong his life . But last week he was told he was too ill for the operation and has weeks to live . The couple are now set to become the first to marry in Torbay Hospital's chapel .

Celtic beat St Mirren 2-0 in their SPL clash on Good Friday night . Leigh Griffiths was caught on camera enjoying a biscuit on the bench during the match . The Bhoys striker warily looked round in the dug-out before unwrapping the tasty treat .

Anthony Clark Reed was driving around Detroit, Michigan, on Monday night . The 24-year-old was pulled over because he had illegally tinted windows . He was handcuffed, despite complaining that he had trouble breathing, before suffering a fatal heart attack . His father, pastor Kevin Clark, claims his son had been 'driving erratically' because he was searching for inhaler . He is planning to sue police for their role in his son's death .

Manny Pacquiao will take on Floyd Mayweather at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas on Saturday night . The 36-year-old has become one of the biggest stars in the world after a series of mega-fights . Pictures have emerged of the Filipino boxer as a teenager in a Manila boxing gym, when occasions such as this Saturday night were just a dream . The pair will make their first public appearances of the week on Tuesday as the bout draws closer .

Arjen Robben has said he has felt 'physically disabled' during his latest spell on the sidelines with a troublesome abdominal injury . The Holland international has missed his side's last three games for Bayern Munich . Robben is expected to miss the Champions League tie against Porto . The former Chelsea star has revealed he will be able to start running again in a few days .

Professional wrestler Robert Abercrombie, known as Rob Venomous, posted video of him pulling out son's tooth . Video shows him revving up the engine of his red Chevrolet Camero before pulling the tooth clean out . After the car stops, James, eight, can be seen running up to the camera with blood smudged across his other teeth, saying 'It came out!'

Prime Minister this morning faced first serious criticism of the campaign so far . Tory donors rounded on the party's lacklustre message and failure to pull away in polls . But a defiant Mr Cameron this afternoon pledged to continue focussing on bread-and-butter issues . He said he would campaign on 'more jobs, more homes, more business, more childcare, more security in retirement'

Stuart McCall confident Shane Ferguson can play a vital role in Rangers push for promotion . Newcastle United wide man has been out injured since joining Ibrox . Ondrej Duda scored after the interval to lead Slovakia to a 1-0 victory over the Czech Republic . The 20-year-old midfielder struck with a low shot from outside the penalty area in the 49th minute for his second international goal . It was the third victory for Slovakia in the 10th match against the Czechs since Czechoslovakia's split in 1993 .

Elijah Overcomer, 26, left Gloriavale, New Zealand's west coast, with his wife, Rosanna, 29, and their three children in late March 2013 . He compared the community's views of the outside world with those held in the psychological thriller The Village, by M. Night Shyamalan . The family were 'blown away' by the kindness and support shown to them by New Zealand churches in Christchurch and Timaru . The Overcomers were also forced to grapple with their views of Christianity .

Andy Murray married Kim Sears this weekend at a service in Dunblane Cathedral . Judy, 55, said she is looking forward to being a granny . The tennis coach said that she will take an active part in their lives . Judy also said that following her stint on Strictly Come Dancing last year she taught Andy some dance moves .
